title: lotoxalis barrelieri
intro: Lotoxalis barrelieri, commonly known as 'False Dandelion', is a flowering plant in the Lotoxalis genus. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its ability to support the digestive system and alleviate symptoms of jaundice, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lotoxalis barrelieri include its potential to act as a choleretic, increasing bile production in the liver, and its antispasmodic properties, which may help to relax muscles and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
